misreadings.quote: the person hearing every sigh is excluded from conversation about his own condition
misreadings.evidence: he had to be content with listening now and then to her sighs and invocations to the saints
misreadings.explanation: The text says Gregor catches her sighs only "now and then", not every one; the translation repeats this as "hear every sigh and invocation".

result.note: The reflection and its prose version track the passage closely; the only issue is the small overstatement "every sigh" in both.
